contentPattern: One row per step. A single-cell row holds the step text (rich text) and gets an auto-generated two-digit number (01, 02, ...). A two-cell row uses cell 1 as a custom number/label and cell 2 as the step text. A vertical track on the left fills with scroll progress (--steps-progress).
usage: Numbered how-to steps and numbered regulation/terms clauses inside a rounded panel, with a vertical progress line on the left.
reuseGuidance: Use for any ordered sequence of text-only steps or clauses. 'tinted' (light lavender panel) and 'dark' (deep purple panel, light text) are color-scheme hooks; the default is a light panel.
